item.content:encoded:
V-Outsourcing Business Group is hiring a part-time Full Stack Developer based in Latin America. This is a fully remote role, Monday through Friday, with working hours aligned with Chicago time.

You’ll build and maintain WordPress and Elementor sites, manage domains, hosting, DNS and SSL, and support website and database migrations and REST API integrations. You’ll also communicate with clients in English about technical issues.

A degree, at least one year of relevant experience, and advanced spoken and written English (C1 or equivalent) are required.

To apply, email your résumé in English and one or two portfolio links with the subject Full Stack Developer. Briefly describe what you personally built or implemented. The interview will be conducted in English.

item.content:encoded:
We are seeking a capable WordPress developer for a short-term, paid website development project.

The client is a privately held Canadian management consulting startup.

The project involves developing approximately six pages from completed design storyboards, supplied branding and approved website content.

The mandatory platform is WordPress using the Gutenberg block editor, Kadence Theme and Kadence Blocks.

We are particularly interested in a student, recent graduate or junior freelancer who has already completed professional-quality WordPress websites.

Our anticipated budget is C$2,000–$2,500 on a fixed-price basis, with an immediate start preferred.

The work can be performed remotely.

We would appreciate receiving examples of relevant completed websites, confirmation of experience with Kadence, and an indication of availability.

The client’s identity and detailed project materials will be provided to shortlisted candidates under appropriate confidentiality arrangements.

If you are interested, or can recommend a suitable developer, we would welcome hearing from you.

Thank you.

item.content:encoded:

————————-

About the Project

We operate the platform of the International Association of Project Managers (IAPM), which includes several websites, a certification system, and a web-based learning platform.

Our current website is based on a historically developed, custom-built CMS with numerous PHP processes and a MySQL database. The goal is to gradually migrate this platform to WordPress, replacing as many custom developments as possible with established WordPress and WooCommerce solutions.

We are looking for an experienced, German-speaking WordPress developer (m/f/d) with excellent PHP skills to support us in this project.

Project Goal

Our goal is to rebuild our current system (including the website) using WordPress and PHP applications. Afterward, the processes will be gradually migrated from the existing system, and the old processes will be deactivated.

First, existing processes will be analyzed and replaced with standard solutions wherever possible. Custom programming will only be undertaken where technically necessary (this will be discussed and further detailed between the client and contractor at the working level).

During the migration, the old and new systems will operate in parallel. The final switchover will only take place after successful completion of the migration.

item.content:encoded:
WordPress / UX Technical Lead serves as the technical authority responsible for the design, development, user experience, accessibility integration, and implementation of the Columbia County Tourism website. The individual will lead discovery, information architecture, WordPress development, UX optimization, API integrations, testing, deployment, and technical quality assurance.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead technical planning, website architecture, and solution design.
  • Conduct discovery sessions, technical assessments, and stakeholder workshops.
  • Design information architecture, sitemap structure, and user journeys.
  • Lead UX/UI strategy to optimize visitor engagement and usability.
  • Develop and configure custom WordPress themes and functionality.
  • Implement responsive, mobile-first website design standards.
  • Integrate third-party applications, APIs, analytics, and interactive maps.
  • Ensure website scalability, security, and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate with content and SEO teams to support destination marketing objectives.
  • Oversee accessibility implementation and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance activities.
  • Conduct technical reviews, testing, and quality assurance validation.
  • Support website launch, staff training, and knowledge transfer activities.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout maintenance and enhancement activities.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in website development and digital solutions.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on WordPress development experience.
  • Experience leading enterprise or tourism-focused website redesign projects.
  • Experience implementing API integrations, analytics, and custom functionality.
  • Demonstrated experience with responsive design and UX best practices.
  • Experience supporting website hosting, maintenance, and security updates.
  • Experience working with public sector, tourism, destination marketing, or municipal organizations preferred.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Web Development, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field.
  • WordPress Development certifications preferred.
  • UX Design or Human-Centered Design certifications preferred.
  • Google Analytics certification preferred.

Compensation: $45.00 – $55.00 per hour
